cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.19)
project(VulkanDevelopmentPackageCheck LANGUAGES NONE)
if(REQUIRE_VULKAN)
    find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED COMPONENTS glslc)
    file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${EXPECTED_VULKAN_PREFIX}/Lib/vulkan-1.lib" expected_library)
    file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${EXPECTED_VULKAN_PREFIX}/Include" expected_include)
    string(TOLOWER "${Vulkan_LIBRARY}" actual_library)
    string(TOLOWER "${Vulkan_INCLUDE_DIR}" actual_include)
    string(TOLOWER "${expected_library}" expected_library)
    string(TOLOWER "${expected_include}" expected_include)
    if(NOT actual_library STREQUAL expected_library OR NOT actual_include STREQUAL expected_include)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Vulkan was found outside the SDK being tested")
    endif()
    enable_language(CXX)
    add_executable(vulkan_link_check vulkan-link-check.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(vulkan_link_check PRIVATE Vulkan::Vulkan)
    message(STATUS "Vulkan library: ${Vulkan_LIBRARY}; headers: ${Vulkan_INCLUDE_DIR}")
endif()
find_package(SPIRV-Headers CONFIG REQUIRED)
if(NOT TARGET SPIRV-Headers::SPIRV-Headers)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SPIRV-Headers package does not export its expected target")
endif()
get_target_property(header_dirs SPIRV-Headers::SPIRV-Headers INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
if(DEFINED EXPECTED_SPIRV_PREFIX)
    file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${EXPECTED_SPIRV_PREFIX}/include" expected_header_dir)
    if(NOT header_dirs STREQUAL expected_header_dir)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SPIRV-Headers came from ${header_dirs}, expected ${expected_header_dir}")
    endif()
endif()
message(STATUS "SPIRV-Headers imported successfully: ${header_dirs}")
